subject.model_revision: GLM-5.3 flagship (official model card 2026-08-17; pay-as-you-go API not yet live, Coding Plan exclusive at capture time)

usage_notes: Advertised-only profile from the official Zhipu docs (docs.bigmodel.cn model card + coding-plan pages) captured 2026-08-17; no provider probe, forwarder smoke, or deployed gateway smoke has run for this identity.

Subscription endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 with a Coding-Plan key; keys and base paths are not interchangeable with the pay-as-you-go endpoint on the same host, and the plan is a separate product from Alibaba Token Plan despite similar naming.

Distinct identity from the Bailian-hosted glm-5.2 route (different vendor channel, provider, and model version) and from any future standard-endpoint glm-5.3; per the extension runbook these are never interchangeable.

Billing is subscription (window/quota-based prompt allowance); no per-token list price exists, so usage ledger cost estimates are intentionally unknown (pricing_missing), never zero. This is the first subscription-billed provider in the catalog.

Thinking is always on and cannot be disabled (thinking.type supports enabled only); reasoning_effort accepts low/high/max with default max; the coding-plan docs' effort-tier mapping folds minimal/light/low into the low tier.
glm-5.3[1m] (1M-context suffix convention referenced by the Claude Code tooling docs) is a separate identity not covered by this profile; the model card documents 1M context as the default spec.

The plan is officially restricted to supported coding tools and product environments (whitelist includes Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Cursor and others); a local transparent gateway in front of whitelisted tools is an operator-accepted gray zone, recorded here deliberately.
General-agent tools (OpenClaw, Cherry Studio, Hermes Agent) are second-class on this plan (queueing/fair-use under load) per the official docs.
